input.summary:
P5 hay loft furnished in parts/room-34.mjs: hay stacks (y7..8) at x62..63 and x66..67 z10..12 flank a 2-wide aisle at x64..65; barrels with lanterns on them at the back east corner, and standing lanterns on the hay tops at (62,9,10) and (66,9,10).
make.sh writes a whole build.nbt; the P5 hay loft line shows 30 placed, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE.
Light is fine (min 12, 0 dark cells). The walk verdict is UNREACHABLE for this room and for every room in this copy, because the loft floor and the entry route are not built here, so the room is not yet verified walkable.
left: Walkability unverified: `mcd room` says 0 of 14 floor cells reachable, but `mcd walk` reports 0 reached for every room, so the entrance route is missing in this copy (the loft floor y6 and the barn ground are not built here). Re-run `mcd room` once shell B and the barn fit-out are in.

Hay drop hole (64..65, 6, 12) in the loft floor: the aisle crosses it, so a player stepping onto (64..65, 7, 12) would fall. The barn fit-out owner should close it with a trapdoor or rail; I kept furniture off it.
The loft door opening (x64..65 y8..9 z9) sits one block above the floor stand (y7), so it cannot be walked through; only the ladder (62,7,14) is an entry. Flagged for the shell/fittings owner.
The hay stacks at x62..63 and x66..67 y7..8 overlap the barn fit-out's loft-bale note; if that part places bales there too, the later writes are refused (no conflict in this copy).
plan.md has no checklist line for this room and elements.md's barn item (hay loft y6 with bales) also covers stalls and the ladder I did not build, so I ticked nothing.

I did not read concept.png before designing the loft, so the detail is not matched to it. The look sheet (room.png) shows only the stacks and lanterns, because the roof and floor are absent in this copy.

waste.what: Checked each loft cell's block by hand with a node one-liner against build.nbt to find out why the room was unreachable (floor, ladder, hole cells).
waste.cost: about 3 tool calls and one retry of the inline script
waste.tool: `mcd walk build.nbt --rooms rooms.json --from x,y,z` (or a per-cell `mcd blocks-at`) would show which cell breaks the walk and what floor exists under it.

waste.what: Worked out the 6x5 floor layout cell by cell in layers() rows, plus which cells the ladder foot and the hay hole need kept clear.
waste.tool: `mcd plan` could print a blank-floor grid with the ladder and hole marked as 'o' so the furniture can be drawn over them directly.

waste.what: Tracked which of the walk verdict's blank floor cells were holes, absent floor, or free air, because `mcd plan` and `mcd room` use blanks for free cells and the outside alike.
waste.cost: a reading error on the first pass, corrected with the node inspection
waste.tool: `mcd room` should print a legend that separates 'no floor under it' from 'free air'.

waste.what: Whole-build walk gives 0 reached for every room, so the room tool cannot tell a local furnishing problem from a missing upstream part.
waste.cost: one full `mcd walk` run plus the cell checks above
waste.tool: `mcd room --from-entrance-check` or a message that names the first unreachable cell on the entrance route would localise it.

companions.task: Build the loft floor at y6 with its ladder hole and the hay drop hole, and close the drop hole with a trapdoor or rail so the aisle is safe to walk.
Confirm the ladder from the barn aisle up x62 z14 reaches the loft floor and that the cell (62,7,14) at the top is clear for the entry.
Check the hay loft's light once the roof is on, and add a hanging lantern from the gambrel beam over the aisle if the dark count goes up.
